application_status.label: 2026 Working Holiday applications are closed
application_status.detail: The Embassy of Japan in the Netherlands posted on 24 September 2026 that Working Holiday visa applications for 2026 are closed.

change_control.review_note: Netherlands baseline verified against the current Embassy Working Holiday page, current 2026 visa-status notice and official document checklist.

summary_facts.label: Residence
summary_facts.value: Dutch national resident in the Netherlands at application

summary_facts.label: Funds baseline
summary_facts.value: €1,800 with return flight; €3,800 with one-way flight

summary_facts.label: Annual quota
summary_facts.value: Up to 200 visas per calendar year

eligibility_rules.label: Are you a Dutch national?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Netherlands Working Holiday route is for Dutch nationals.

eligibility_rules.label: Are you resident in the Netherlands at the time of application?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Dutch Working Holiday applicants must live in the Netherlands when applying.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Dutch Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The programme is not intended for full-time employment, internships or academic enrolment.

eligibility_rules.label: Will dependants without their own eligible status accompany you?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Dependants may only accompany the applicant if independently entitled to enter Japan.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the good-health, insurance and no-criminal-record requirements?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The programme requires good health, adequate medical insurance, a sound background and no criminal record.

funds_rule.input_label: Funds shown on your Dutch bank statement (€)
funds_rule.no_ticket_note: The €3,800 figure applies with a confirmed one-way flight. The Embassy's checklist requires a one-way or round-trip flight booking confirmation.

jurisdiction.label: Embassy of Japan in the Netherlands
jurisdiction.description: Dutch Working Holiday applicants must live in the Netherlands. Applications are handled by the Embassy; the current general visa page allows in-person or proxy submission, not post or email, and does not require an appointment.
jurisdiction.ui_help: You must be a Dutch national living in the Netherlands to use this route.

options.label: I am a Dutch national living in the Netherlands
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in the Netherlands
options.mission_detail: Use the Embassy's current visa counter procedure. Current guidance says no appointment is required and applications are not accepted by post or email.

options.label: I am not currently living in the Netherlands
options.mission_label: Dutch Working Holiday route may not apply
options.mission_detail: The Working Holiday rules require Dutch nationals to reside in the Netherlands when applying.
options.issue: The Netherlands Working Holiday route requires the applicant to be a Dutch national resident in the Netherlands at the time of application.

document_checklist.title: Valid Dutch passport
document_checklist.description: Provide a valid Dutch passport with at least one blank visa page.

document_checklist.title: Completed visa application form
document_checklist.description: Complete and sign one current visa application form.

document_checklist.title: Recent passport photograph
document_checklist.description: Provide a passport-type photograph of about 45mm × 35mm, taken within the previous six months.

document_checklist.title: Curriculum Vitae
document_checklist.description: Prepare the current Working Holiday CV / resume.

document_checklist.title: Outline of stay and activities
document_checklist.description: Prepare a detailed intended-stay/activity outline without placeholder entries such as 'unknown'.

document_checklist.title: One-page motivation letter
document_checklist.description: Provide at least one full A4 page explaining the reason for applying.

document_checklist.title: Confirmed flight booking
document_checklist.description: Provide a confirmed one-way or round-trip flight booking from an airline or travel agency.

document_checklist.title: Recent bank statement
document_checklist.description: Show at least €3,800 with a one-way flight or €1,800 with a return flight.

document_checklist.title: National Health Insurance pledge
document_checklist.description: Provide the current Kokumin Kenko Hoken pledge form.

preparation_checklist.title: Wait for the next application intake
preparation_checklist.description: The Embassy's current 24 September 2026 notice says 2026 Working Holiday applications are closed.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm Netherlands residence
preparation_checklist.description: Dutch nationals must live in the Netherlands when applying.

preparation_checklist.title: Align funds with your flight booking
preparation_checklist.description: The financial threshold differs between a return booking and a one-way booking.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final Embassy check
preparation_checklist.description: Check the current visa page for reopening/quota information before preparing a future application.
